description: This file implements multiple inter-process communication (IPC) remote endpoints and their associated threads using Zephyr RTOS. It sets up endpoint configurations, thread functions for each endpoint, and manages message passing and synchronization via semaphores.

methods.name: ipc0A_ept_bound
methods.description: Callback invoked when endpoint 0A is bound, signals semaphore.

methods.name: ipc0A_ept_recv
methods.description: Callback invoked when data is received on endpoint 0A, stores data and signals semaphore.

methods.name: ipc0A_entry
methods.description: Thread function for IPC endpoint 0A, opens service, registers endpoint, and exchanges messages.

methods.name: ipc0B_ept_bound
methods.description: Callback invoked when endpoint 0B is bound, signals semaphore.

methods.name: ipc0B_ept_recv
methods.description: Callback invoked when data is received on endpoint 0B, stores data and signals semaphore.

methods.name: ipc0B_entry
methods.description: Thread function for IPC endpoint 0B, opens service, registers endpoint, and exchanges messages.

methods.name: ipc1_ept_bound
methods.description: Callback invoked when endpoint 1 is bound, signals semaphore.

methods.name: ipc1_ept_recv
methods.description: Callback invoked when data is received on endpoint 1, stores data and signals semaphore.

methods.name: ipc1_entry
methods.description: Thread function for IPC instance 1, opens service, registers endpoint, and exchanges messages.
